title: Shipper Lead Qualification and Quote Automation
summary: Qualify inbound shipper enquiries from web, email and WhatsApp, collect lane, volume and cargo details, and draft quotes from your rate cards for a salesperson to approve.

seo.title: Shipper Lead Qualification and Quote Automation | VipraTech
seo.description: AI that qualifies shipper enquiries, captures lanes, volumes and cargo details, and drafts quotes from your rate cards for sales team approval.

problem.intro: Logistics companies get enquiries from website forms, emails, WhatsApp, marketplaces and referrals: a one-off part load from Pune to Guwahati, a monthly FTL contract, an export LCL shipment, a warehousing requirement. Sales teams chase missing details, wait on pricing, and many leads go cold before a quote reaches the shipper.

pain_points.title: Enquiries missing key details
pain_points.detail: Origin, destination, cargo type, weight, dimensions, frequency and timelines arrive incomplete, so the first exchanges are spent collecting basics.

pain_points.title: Slow quotes
pain_points.detail: Pricing teams build quotes by hand from rate cards, vendor rates and surcharges, and simple spot quotes wait behind large RFQs.

pain_points.title: Poor-fit leads take time
pain_points.detail: Enquiries for lanes, cargo types or volumes you do not serve get the same attention as good-fit ones.

pain_points.title: No follow-up discipline
pain_points.detail: Quotes sent by email are not followed up consistently, and nobody records why leads were lost.

solution.overview: We build an enquiry assistant that responds on your website, email and WhatsApp, asks for missing details in a short conversation and structures the lead: lanes, mode, cargo, weight and dimensions, frequency, special handling and timelines. It checks fit against your service coverage and minimum volumes, scores the lead and routes it to the right branch or vertical. For standard lanes it drafts a quote from your rate cards, fuel surcharge and accessorial rules; for RFQs it extracts lane tables from the shipper's spreadsheet into your pricing template. A salesperson approves every quote, and follow-ups and outcomes are recorded in your CRM.
capabilities: Captures enquiries from web forms, email, WhatsApp and marketplaces in one queue
Asks follow-up questions to complete lane, cargo, volume and timeline details
Scores fit against your lanes, modes, cargo types and minimum volumes
Drafts spot quotes from rate cards, fuel surcharge and accessorial rules
Extracts lane tables from RFQ spreadsheets into your pricing template
Schedules follow-ups and records win or loss reasons in the CRM

workflow.title: Enquiry arrives
workflow.detail: A shipper submits a form, sends an email or messages on WhatsApp, and the enquiry lands in one queue.

workflow.title: Complete the details
workflow.detail: The assistant asks for missing information such as dimensions, frequency or pickup dates.

workflow.title: Score and route
workflow.detail: The lead is scored against your coverage and routed to the right branch, vertical or inside sales.

workflow.title: Draft the quote
workflow.detail: Standard lanes get a draft quote from rate cards; RFQ lanes are extracted for the pricing team.

workflow.title: Sales approval
workflow.detail: A salesperson or pricing manager reviews, edits and approves the quote before it is sent.

workflow.title: Follow up and record
workflow.detail: Follow-ups are scheduled, and outcomes and reasons are recorded in the CRM.

inputs: Enquiries from forms, email, WhatsApp and marketplaces
Rate cards, fuel surcharge and accessorial rules
Service coverage: lanes, pin codes, modes and cargo types
outputs: Structured, scored leads routed to the right team
RFQ lane tables in your pricing template
Win or loss reasons and pipeline reports
human_in_the_loop: A salesperson or pricing manager approves every quote before it reaches the shipper, and pricing builds all non-standard and contract quotes. The system never commits capacity or rates on its own.
integrations: CRM such as Salesforce, Zoho or HubSpot
TMS or pricing tool holding rate cards
guardrails: No quote sent without human approval
Quotes carry a validity period and stated assumptions
Only current, approved rate cards used
Shipper data used only for the enquiry and follow-ups they asked for
Opt-outs honoured on WhatsApp and email follow-ups
compliance_notes: Follow-up messages follow WhatsApp Business policies and TRAI commercial communication rules where applicable.
Lead personal data is processed in line with the DPDP Act 2023, and GDPR for shippers in the EU.

pilot.scope: Inbound enquiries for one mode, such as PTL or FTL, from the website and WhatsApp, with quote drafts for your most-quoted lanes.
deliverables: Enquiry flows for web and WhatsApp
Digitised rate cards for the pilot lanes
CRM integration in a test environment
Pilot report on lead quality and quote turnaround

what_we_measure.how: Leads arriving at sales with all required details, out of all pilot leads.
Time from enquiry to approved quote, compared with recent enquiries before the pilot.
Changes salespeople make to drafted quotes before approval.
Leads re-routed by sales because they reached the wrong team.

faqs.q: Will the system send quotes without our approval?
faqs.a: No. Every quote is drafted for a salesperson or pricing manager to review and approve. You may later allow automatic sending for specific standard lanes, but that is your decision.

faqs.q: Our pricing depends on vendor rates that change daily. Can it handle that?
faqs.a: For spot pricing tied to market vendor rates, the system collects the enquiry and drafts the quote structure, and your pricing team adds the rate. Standard contract lanes can use stored rate cards.

faqs.q: Can it read shipper RFQ spreadsheets?
faqs.a: Yes. RFQ files with lane tables are extracted into your pricing template, with unclear rows flagged. Your pricing team then fills in or reviews the rates.
We integrate through your CRM's API, for example Salesforce, Zoho or HubSpot. If you do not use a CRM yet, the pilot can start with a simple lead board.
